configuration.chexsonsaeutils.craftingCo: Enable AE2 crafting continuation / ignore-missing feature. Allows crafting to continue when some patterns are temporarily unavailable. Takes effect after restart.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.formalMach: Enable formal machine large-request planning aggregation fast path. Optimizes planning for bulk crafting requests. Takes effect after restart.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.processing: Enable AE2 processing pattern replacement feature. Allows dynamic pattern substitution based on available materials. Takes effect after restart.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.dyeablePat: Enable AEA dyeable pattern migration. Extends AE2 pattern color handling while preserving existing replacement, continuation, formal-machine, and Unhindered Hub planning semantics. Takes effect after restart.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.enhancedCr: Enable AEA enhanced crafting status migration. Adds Blocked and Pattern Times status data without replacing existing continuation, formal-machine, or Unhindered Hub UI state. Takes effect after restart.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.craftingAm: Number style for the short amounts shown in the crafting confirm table. Allowed values: abbreviated (1.5K, 16Qi, 2De), scientific (1.50e3, 1.62e19). Only affects the in-cell column; tooltips always keep the full unabbreviated amount. Takes effect immediately.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.buildingGa: Enable AEA Building Gadgets 2 template-to-processing-pattern integration. Has no effect unless Building Gadgets 2 is installed. Generates standard AE2 processing patterns. Takes effect after restart.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.ftbUltimin: Enable AEA FTB Ultimine memory-card compatibility. Has no effect unless FTB Ultimine is installed. Does not change AE2 single-target memory-card behavior. Takes effect after restart.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.parallelCr: Enable Unhindered Hub
Enable the Unhindered Hub block. Takes effect after restart.
Co-Processors per vCPU
Advertised co-processors per virtual CPU. The Unhindered Hub has no storage limit, so co-processors are the true throughput constraint.
Max Lanes per Block
Maximum internal crafting lanes per tool block.
Max Lanes per Grid
Maximum internal crafting lanes per AE grid.
Max Submissions per Tick
Maximum parallel CPU job submissions accepted per grid tick.
Max Pattern Pushes per Tick
Maximum pattern pushes budgeted per grid tick.
Max Provider Checks per Tick
Maximum provider checks budgeted per grid tick.
Tick Budget (Nanoseconds)
Maximum wall-clock CPU scheduling budget per grid tick. Clamped to 45 ms.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.graphPlann: Enable the level-1 graph crafting-planning engine. The planning neighbourhood is compiled once into an immutable graph and solved linearly. Anything it cannot express yet (multiple routes, fuzzy variants, recursive patterns) falls back to the native AE2 path. Takes effect immediately.

Wall-clock budget in milliseconds for one graph planning session, shared by graph compilation and every solve probe. On exhaustion the calculation falls back to the tree path. 0 disables the budget. Takes effect immediately.

Experimental: at multi-route competition points the graph planner fires every candidate route on a ledger copy and keeps the lexicographically best plan (fewest leftovers, then fewest network items, then fewest crafts, then fewest bytes) instead of first-come-first-served. Changes route selection results and costs one extra ledger pass per candidate. Takes effect immediately.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.parallelCr: Lane Shard Count
Shard count used by the extreme-lane scheduler.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.recipeMapp: Local direct processing machine recipe mappings. Format: machine_id=recipe_type_id=default_ticks. Example: mymod:crusher=mymod:crushing=40. Only affects the AE direct processing machine discovery layer.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.budgetProf: Execution budget profile for the AE direct processing machine. Allowed values: normal, high, benchmark. Benchmark is intended for controlled performance tests.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.genericDis: Enable generic recipe type discovery for the AE direct processing machine. When disabled, only explicit adapters and config/datapack mappings are used.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.extremeAss: When disabled, placed machines stop processing. Blocks and items remain registered for world compatibility. Takes effect immediately.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.aeDirectPr: When disabled, placed machines stop processing. Blocks and items remain registered for world compatibility. Takes effect immediately.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.customPatt: When disabled, providers stop active extraction, pattern pushing, and energy injection. Blocks and items remain registered for world compatibility. Takes effect immediately.

One return-bar slot of the custom pattern provider may exceed the item stack size limit, so a full machine output slot is pulled in one pass. When disabled, new writes are clamped to the original per-slot limit; content already above the limit is still returned to the network in full. Click an oversized slot to withdraw one stack. Takes effect immediately.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.maxCustomP: Pattern page cap of the custom pattern provider. Each page holds 36 pattern slots; extra pages are unlocked by consuming ExtendedAE pattern providers in the upgrade screen. Takes effect after restart.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.multiLevel: When disabled, emitters always read as off. Parts remain registered for world compatibility. Takes effect immediately.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.autoItemGe: When disabled, the auto item generator (debug) block stops generating items. Takes effect immediately.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.infinityCe: When disabled, the infinity storage cell is not registered as a storage device. Takes effect after restart.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.slotNumber: Enable the client-side slot number overlay (network tool + Alt+I). Takes effect immediately.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.totalPatte: Total pattern slot capacity of the machine. Shrinking below a machine's used slots may affect existing saves.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.maxQueueTa: Maximum tasks kept in the execution queue per machine.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.maxPending: Maximum output batches buffered before backpressure rejects new work.
Cap for the exponential retry delay when returning output to the network fails.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.dirtyPatte: Dirty pattern slot refreshes budgeted per tick per machine.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.defaultBas: Base crafting duration in ticks before speed card reduction.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.localExecu: Maximum tasks kept in each host's local execution queue.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.tickSoftBu: Soft wall-clock budget per host tick in nanos.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.tickHardBu: Hard wall-clock budget per host tick in nanos.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.tickAbsolu: Absolute wall-clock budget per host tick in nanos. Should stay above the hard budget.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.completion: Completion slices processed before forcing a progress save.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.queueProgr: Queue mutations processed before forcing a progress save.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.parallelCr: Provider Backoff Base (ticks)
Base exponential backoff delay in ticks for busy pattern providers.
Provider Backoff Max (ticks)
Maximum backoff delay in ticks for busy pattern providers.
Max Pattern Extracts / Tick
Maximum pattern input extractions budgeted per grid tick.
Max Pattern Reinjections / Tick
Maximum pattern input reinjections budgeted per grid tick.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.graphPlanC: Writes logs/chexsonsaeutils-plan-capture-*.json for every request taking the graph path: the crafting service view (patterns, emittable keys, fuzzy craftables) plus the stock snapshot, so the built-in benchmark can replay the exact request offline. Debug aid only - leave it off during normal play. Takes effect immediately.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.parallelCr: Parallel CPU Execution Diagnostics

Logs batch execution, stalls, submissions, restores and normal BigInteger receipts. Disabled by default and applies immediately. Actual submission failures and abnormal receipts still produce warnings.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.graphPlann: Adds per-site / per-key lines to the graph planning trace (requires graph planning diagnostics). Line count scales with the site tree, so one large modpack request emits tens of megabytes and the formatting alone costs about a second - only enable it to debug a single request. Takes effect immediately.

Post-solve conservation check: every key is verified for supply (extractions, emissions, ring seeds, pattern outputs) >= demand (inputs, final output, missing) before a graph plan is accepted. Violations decline to the tree path. Takes effect immediately.
Maximum planning recursion depth for the graph solver; deeper chains decline to the tree path. Takes effect immediately.
configuration.chexsonsaeutils.hostBatchM: Target number of crafting pushes per host batch: the planner splits each host chain into batch patterns of roughly this many base operations so the CPU can start a batch before the whole chain is supplied. Takes effect immediately.
